_comment: Single source for what an alert sounds and looks like.
The hook does not read this at runtime: scripts/build/gen-alert-tables.py
turns it into generated/alerts.zsh, which the event hook sources. The
Python fetchers and herdr-sounds-sync read this file directly. Edit here,
then regenerate — the plugin's [[build]] step does it on install.

games._comment: game -> media sources. archive:<item> is an archive.org id, git:<url> a source repo (sprites, or sounds when the repo ships its own named clips), mix:<item> encrypted game archives. HTTPS sprite ZIPs use sprites_sha256 for integrity.

sprite_sound._comment: Red Alert sprite -> the clip that belongs with it. An alert that names one of these sprites and no clip gets its sound from here, so the pairing is stated once.

moods._comment: What happened -> which named Mario clip. Synonyms share a clip; an alert refers to any one of them.

_comment: The named alerts a user picks between: HERDR_ALERT_BLOCKED=tesla.
A clip comes from `clip` (exact basename), `mood` (looked up in moods), or
`sprite` (looked up in sprite_sound) — in that order. An alert with none of
them plays a random clip from its game, which is the only thing worth doing
for the packs whose clips are numbered rather than named.
`vibe` is a short English tag read only by `herdr-alert auto`, so an LLM
picking a project-fitting alert from branch names and commit messages has
something to match against; it is not read by the hook or the build step.

unit-ready.vibe: a unit awaiting orders -- calm readiness

tesla.vibe: a tesla coil charging up -- aggressive offense, combat energy

harvester.vibe: resource harvesting -- steady accumulation, data/ETL work

orca.vibe: an airstrike inbound -- fast, decisive attack

kaboom.vibe: an explosion -- something just broke loudly, a crash or outage

redalert.vibe: general wartime alarm -- urgent, all-hands incident

win.vibe: stage-clear fanfare -- a clean, satisfying finish

1up.vibe: earning an extra life -- a nice win, shipped/merged

coin.vibe: a coin pickup -- small steady progress, one step at a time

powerup.vibe: gaining a power-up -- an upgrade, a dependency bump, new capability

die.vibe: a death jingle -- a bug fix, a crash, something failed

stomp.vibe: jumping on a Koopa -- squashing a bug, finishing it off for good

gameover.vibe: game over -- a fatal error, a hard abort, a severe regression

waiting.vibe: treading water -- blocked on review, waiting on something external

dk.vibe: a boss looming over the work -- a big, imposing refactor or migration

barrel.vibe: dodging rolling barrels -- firefighting, dealing with a stream of obstacles

punchout.vibe: a boxing match -- a head-to-head fight, adversarial debugging, a tough opponent bug

spin.vibe: a speed dash -- fast-moving work, a quick turnaround, performance tuning

codec.vibe: a stealth codec call -- security work, covert ops, hardening, sneaking past a hard problem

kirby.vibe: cute and gentle -- low-stakes polish, docs, cosmetic/UI tweaks

states._comment: The alert each herdr transition plays by default. HERDR_ALERT_BLOCKED / HERDR_ALERT_DONE name a different one; HERDR_SOUND_* still beats both with a literal path.
